description: EdDSA on a set holding only an X25519 key fails with NoMatchingKey; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): X25519 never matches EdDSA (RFC 8037 §3.2 is key agreement), so zero members match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
